title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

£30,000 Nuneaton

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Executive to join an established, market-leading consumer brand, supporting the delivery of engaging marketing campaigns across multiple channels.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially minded marketer who enjoys managing projects, coordinating campaigns and working with creative agencies to bring marketing activity to life. You'll work closely with teams across Marketing, Sales, Trade, Communications and Product Development, gaining exposure to a broad range of projects and the opportunity to take ownership of your work.

The Role
- Coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across brand, trade, retail and other channels.
- Manage marketing projects from initial briefing through to final delivery, ensuring deadlines and objectives are met.
- Write clear, effective briefs for external creative and marketing agencies, managing their output to ensure high-quality delivery.
- Support brand campaigns, channel activation and premium product launches.
- Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders across Sales, Trade, Product Development and Communications.
- Coordinate the development of marketing assets, promotional materials and campaign content.
- Contribute to copywriting and the creation of engaging marketing communications.
- Use Canva to create and adapt marketing materials where required.
- Monitor project progress, coordinate stakeholders and ensure marketing activity is delivered to a high standard.

About You
- Previous experience in a marketing role, ideally within a B2 C environment.
- Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Experience briefing and working with external agencies.
- A good understanding of brand marketing, integrated campaigns and channel activation.
- Excellent written communication skills, including copywriting and preparing marketing briefs.
- Confident working with stakeholders across different departments.
- Experience using Canva and coordinating creative assets.
- A proactive, commercially minded approach, with strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering effective marketing campaigns.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000.
- In-office for the first 4 month probation then hybrid working
- A 35-hour working week: Monday to Thursday, 9am-5pm, and Friday, 9am-4pm.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- The opportunity to work across a variety of marketing channels, campaigns and product launches.
- Excellent exposure to cross-functional teams and external creative agencies, providing opportunities to develop your marketing career.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Job title Marketing Manager

Contract type Fixed-term contract

Working pattern Hybrid (office and remote)

Salary Competitive

Focus areas Customer journeys and engagement, owned and paid campaign delivery, acquisition and switching, payments growth, and programme delivery

About the role

We are looking for Marketing Managers to plan and deliver marketing on a contract basis. Each role will focus on a mix of the areas below, depending on business priorities:
- Customer journeys and engagement: improve onboarding and in-life journeys so customers become active and do more with us.
- Campaign delivery: take campaigns from brief to live across owned and paid channels.
- Acquisition: win new customers, including switching and premium product acquisition.
- Payments growth: increase debit card and digital wallet usage.
- Programme delivery: keep internal teams, partners and agencies aligned and delivering to plan.

The role suits an organised, analytical marketer who is comfortable with data, manages several workstreams at once and turns insight into campaigns.

Key responsibilities
- Customer journeys and engagement
- Map the new customer journey from sign-up and find where customers drop off.
- Design onboarding communications that drive activation, first card use and digital wallet set-up.
- Review in-life communications, identify gaps and overlaps, and build triggered, data-led journeys for key customer moments.
- Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to hold and use more products.
- Work with CRM and data teams on segmentation, targeting and journey set-up.

Owned and paid channel delivery
- Deliver campaigns across owned channels, such as email, push notifications, website and direct mail.
- Deliver campaigns across paid channels, such as paid social, paid search, display and partner media.
- Turn campaign plans into briefs, timelines and channel schedules, and keep delivery on track.
- Coordinate approvals and launch checks, working with compliance and risk teams so communications meet regulatory requirements.
- Manage day-to-day work with agencies and internal creative teams.

Acquisition

Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to switch to the product and make it their main way to pay.

Run incentive and prize draw campaigns from launch to close, including entry communications, terms and conditions, and winner communications.

Deliver owned and paid campaigns that acquire new customers into premium card and payment propositions.

Track switching, activation and acquisition volumes, and suggest improvements.

Payments growth: debit and digital wallet

Deliver campaigns that encourage customers to use their card for everyday payments.

Drive digital wallet adoption and usage, from set-up to first transaction.

Analyse spend and transaction data to find opportunities and measure campaign results.

Work with product and payments teams on offers, incentives and messaging.

Programme delivery and governance
- Build and maintain the integrated programme plan, with milestones, dependencies and owners, and flag delays or blockers early.
- Run programme governance, including steering meetings, status reporting and the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies).
- Coordinate briefs, timelines, reviews and approvals across internal teams, partners and agencies, with clear handovers and ownership.
- Act as a point of contact for programme updates and escalations, and track spend against the agreed budget.

Performance and reporting

Track engagement, retention, product-holding and channel metrics, and share results and learnings.

Produce regular performance reports and dashboards for marketing leads and senior stakeholders.

What you'll bring

Essential

Marketing, CRM, campaign or programme experience in payments, fintech or financial services.

Experience delivering campaigns across owned and paid channels, including lifecycle, onboarding or engagement activity.

Strong analytical skills, with confidence using data to find insights and report on performance.

Good organisation and planning skills, and the ability to manage several campaigns or workstreams at once.

Experience working with stakeholders across internal teams, partners and agencies.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Desirable
- Knowledge of premium product acquisition, or prize draw and incentive campaigns.
- Understanding of debit card and digital wallet products and customer payment behaviour.
- Experience with journey mapping, CRM or marketing automation platforms.
- Experience in a PMO, programme management or implementation role on marketing programmes.
- Knowledge of financial services marketing regulations and working with compliance teams.

Package & working arrangements
- Salary: Competitive
- Contract: Fixed-term contract. Length and start date to be confirmed.
- Working pattern: Hybrid, with time split between the office and home.

title: Temporary CRM Assistant
description:
Temporary CRM Assistant (MC633)

When registering to this job board you will be redirected to the online application form. Please ensure that this is completed in full in order that your application can be reviewed.

The Original British Motorcycling Company

Temporary CRM Assistant - This is a 12-Month contract. Please note this is a fully onsite position.

We're seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Temporary CRM Assistant to join our Central Marketing Team. This is an exciting opportunity to support the delivery of large-scale, data-driven marketing campaigns for a globally recognised brand. Working closely with the Global CRM Manager and wider marketing team, you'll help create and deploy customer communications that engage, retain, and re-engage audiences across multiple markets. This role would be particularly suited to a recent Marketing graduate or an individual looking to develop their career within CRM and digital marketing.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Support the planning, build, and deployment of CRM campaigns and automated customer journeys.

Manage the scheduling and deployment of global email marketing communications, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.

Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics such as open rates, click-through rates, and conversions to drive continuous improvement.

Use Google Analytics, A/B testing, and customer insights to optimise engagement and marketing effectiveness.

Create and adapt engaging email content, assets, and copy to support global marketing campaigns and customer communications.

Skills & Experience required:

Recent Marketing graduate or with some practical work experience with CRM systems.

Confident user of Microsoft Office software, especially with Excel.

Experience with utilising reporting tools.

Understanding of Dynamics 365 and experience with large datasets would be desirable.

Strong organisation skills with the ability to prioritise, multitask, and work independently.

Hours of Work: 39 hrs per week, Monday to Friday.

Full details of the job description and person specification can be found in the downloadable job files. Join us for the Ride!

Disclaimer: due to the high volume of applications we receive, we reserve the right to close a vacancy earlier than the advertised date. This is to ensure our teams can manage application levels while maintaining a positive candidate experience. Once a vacancy has closed, we are unable to consider further applications, so please submit your application as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.
